parsed.post: Huge jump! Changing TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' (using all 11 shards) dropped val_bpb from 1.040 to 0.899. This is the best result I've seen so far. Now that we have more data, I'll try increasing the model's capacity by increasing DEPTH to 8 to see if it can better model this extra information.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 8 to add model capacity, building on the massive gain from switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'.
